## Purpose
How the project runs locally and on an Azure VM from the same code: the local-versus-production table (frontend, backend, Tool Service, Neo4j, routing, config), the `deploy/` files, VM creation, setup and deploy steps, and operations.

## Accuracy
Current. It matches `deploy/docker-compose.yml`, `deploy/Caddyfile`, the Azure scripts, and the backend and `frontend-3` Dockerfiles:
- the default VM size is Standard_D4s_v5;
- do not go below 8 GiB of RAM;
- ports 22, 80 and 443.

## Used by
Operators deploying the platform.

## Replication notes
Copy it verbatim. It is the operational guide for the `deploy/` folder.
